english: They made a killing on the stock market.
transcription: [ðeɪ meɪd ə ˈkɪlɪŋ ɒn ðə stɒk ˈmɑːkɪt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about killing — it means made a huge profit.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об убийстве — значит получить огромную прибыль.

english: This deal will make or break us.
transcription: [ðɪs diːl wɪl meɪk ɔː(r) breɪk ʌs]

meanings.translation: Это либо спасёт, либо погубит нас.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about making or breaking — it means decide success or failure.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о создании и разрушении — значит решить успех или провал.

english: There's more to it than meets the eye.
transcription: [ðeəz mɔː(r) tə ɪt ðæn miːts ði aɪ]

meanings.translation1: Всё не так просто, как кажется.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about eyes — it means more complex than it appears.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о глазах — значит сложнее, чем кажется.

english: It's free, no strings attached.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real strings — it means no hidden conditions.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о верёвках — значит без скрытых условий.

english: He said it off the cuff.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a cuff — it means without preparation.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о манжете — значит без подготовки.

english: They travel on a shoestring.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about shoestrings — it means with very little money.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о шнурках — значит с очень маленьким бюджетом.

english: He's still on the fence about it.
transcription: [hiːz stɪl ɒn ðə fens əˈbaʊt ɪt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a fence — it means refusing to choose.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о заборе — значит не выбирать сторону.

english: Once bitten, twice shy.

meanings.translation1: Обжёгшись на молоке, дуешь на воду.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about biting — it means once hurt, you become cautious.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об укусе — значит после обиды становишься осторожным.

english: He went out on a limb for you.

meanings.translation: Он поставил себя под удар ради тебя.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a limb — it means took a risk to support someone.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о конечности — значит рискнуть, поддерживая кого-то.

english: She passed the exam with flying colours.
transcription: [ʃiː pɑːst ði ɪɡˈzæm wɪð ˈflaɪɪŋ ˈkʌləz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about colours — it means with great success.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о цветах — значит с большим успехом.

english: I'm just playing devil's advocate.

meanings.translation: Я просто проверяю идею на прочность.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the devil — it means argue the opposite for the sake of debate.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о дьяволе — значит спорить с противоположной позиции ради дискуссии.

english: They pulled the plug on the project.
transcription: [ðeɪ pʊld ðə plʌɡ ɒn ðə ˈprɒdʒekt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about electricity — it means stopped something.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об электричестве — значит остановить что-то.

english: She finally put her foot down.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real foot — it means firmly refuse or insist.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о ноге — значит твёрдо отказать или настоять на своём.

english: They raised the bar for everyone.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real bar — it means set a higher standard.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о планке — значит установить более высокий стандарт.

english: There's too much red tape.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real tape — it means excessive bureaucracy.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о ленте — значит чрезмерная бюрократия.

english: You're robbing Peter to pay Paul.

meanings.translation: Ты берёшь у одного, чтобы отдать другому.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real people — it means take from one to pay another.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о людях — значит брать у одного, чтобы отдать другому.

english: Don't rub salt in the wound.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about salt — it means make someone feel worse.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о соли — значит заставлять кого-то чувствовать себя хуже.

english: It's just a run-of-the-mill product.
transcription: [ɪts dʒʌst ə rʌn əv ðə mɪl ˈprɒdʌkt]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a mill — it means ordinary, nothing special.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о мельнице — значит обычный, ничего особенного.

english: He saw the writing on the wall.
transcription: [hiː sɔː ðə ˈraɪtɪŋ ɒn ðə wɔːl]

meanings.translation1: Он понял, что всё идёт к плохому.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about real writing — it means recognise an inevitable future.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о надписи — значит осознать неизбежное будущее.

english: I smell a rat.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real rat — it means suspect something is wrong.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о крысе — значит подозревать, что что-то не так.

english: He spilled the beans.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about beans — it means revealed a secret.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о бобах — значит раскрыть секрет.

english: They stole a march on their rivals.
transcription: [ðeɪ stəʊl ə mɑːtʃ ɒn ðeə(r) ˈraɪvlz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about stealing — it means gain an advantage secretly.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о краже — значит тайно получить преимущество.

english: He took the bull by the horns.
transcription: [hiː tʊk ðə bʊl baɪ ðə hɔːnz]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a bull — it means dealt with a problem directly.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о быке — значит смело взяться за проблему.

english: The ball's in your court now.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about tennis — it means it's now your responsibility.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о теннисе — значит теперь твоя ответственность.

english: The bottom line is we need more money.
transcription: [ðə ˈbɒtəm laɪn ɪz wiː niːd mɔː(r) ˈmʌni]

meanings.translation1: Суть в том, что нам нужно больше денег.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about the bottom of a page — it means the main point.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о нижней строке — значит главное.

english: That was the last straw.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a straw — it means the final problem that makes you lose patience.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о соломинке — значит последняя капля терпения.

english: He threw in the towel.

meanings.exampleSentence: Comes from boxing — not about a towel, it means give up.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Из бокса — не о полотенце, значит сдаться.

english: He threw his colleague under the bus.
transcription: [hiː θruː hɪz ˈkɒliːɡ ˈʌndə(r) ðə bʌs]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about a real bus — it means betray someone to save yourself.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о настоящем автобусе — значит подставить кого-то ради себя.

english: It's just the tip of the iceberg.
transcription: [ɪts dʒʌst ðə tɪp əv ði ˈaɪsbɜːɡ]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about ice — it means a small visible part of a bigger problem.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о льде — значит малая часть большой проблемы.

english: He turned a deaf ear to my request.
transcription: [hiː tɜːnd ə def ɪə(r) tə maɪ rɪˈkwest]

meanings.translation1: Он пропустил мою просьбу мимо ушей.
meanings.translation: Он не обратил внимания на мою просьбу.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about ears — it means deliberately ignore.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не об ушах — значит намеренно игнорировать.

english: They're two sides of the same coin.
transcription: [ðeə(r) tuː saɪdz əv ðə seɪm kɔɪn]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about coins — it means closely connected aspects.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о монетах — значит тесно связанные стороны.

english: Everything is still up in the air.
transcription: [ˈevriθɪŋ ɪz stɪl ʌp ɪn ði eə(r)]

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about air — it means undecided.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о воздухе — значит ничего не решено.

english: I have to walk on eggshells around him.
transcription: [aɪ hæv tə wɔːk ɒn ˈeɡʃelz əˈraʊnd hɪm]

meanings.translation1: Мне приходится с ним быть очень осторожным.
meanings.translation: Я с ним как по яйцам хожу.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about eggs — it means being very careful not to upset someone.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о яйцах — значит быть очень осторожным, чтобы не расстроить.

english: That's water under the bridge.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about water — it means past events that no longer matter.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о воде — значит прошлое, которое уже не важно.

english: That's a wild goose chase.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about geese — it means a hopeless search.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о гусях — значит безнадёжные поиски.

english: Without a shadow of a doubt.

meanings.exampleSentence: Not about shadows — it means completely certain.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о тенях — значит абсолютно уверен.

english: You can't teach an old dog new tricks.
transcription: [juː kɑːnt tiːtʃ ən əʊld dɒɡ njuː trɪks]

meanings.translation1: Старого пса новым трюкам не научишь.
meanings.exampleSentence: Not about dogs — it means old people are hard to change.
meanings.exampleTranslation: Не о собаках — значит взрослого человека трудно изменить.
